name: A100_benchmark_gpt-fast
description: A dataset for benchmarking performance of GPT-fast-style models on NVIDIA A100 hardware, providing traces and measurements of runtime behavior across configurations. It captures metrics such as latency and throughput for model inference under different settings to facilitate system-level comparisons and optimizations. The dataset is intended for systems researchers and engineers evaluating model/hardware tradeoffs.
reputation: Niche community dataset primarily used for GPU/model runtime benchmarking; limited adoption outside specialized system-performance researchers.
